name: R(e)Born_
source:
A closeted trans woman undergoes a procedure to finally live as herself and begin a new life. She wakes up to an endless void where she cannot hear anything, nor control or feel her body whatsoever. How did she get here?

[From [url=https://froey.itch.io/reborn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名未出柜的跨性别女性接受手术，最终以自己的方式生活并开始新的生活。她醒来时发现一片无尽的虚空，她听不到任何声音，也无法控制或感觉自己的身体。她是怎么到这里来的？

[来自[url=https://froey.itch.io/reborn]itch.io[/url]]
